The pink bunny bedroom has a full canopy-height bed with a plaid quilt, a bedside table and lamp, wall shelves of books and plushies, framed bunny pictures, plants and a rug. The star-blue bedroom has a blue star quilt bed, bookshelf, globe, telescope, desk and string lights. The bathroom has a glass shower with a towel, a wood vanity with sink, mirror and plants, and a bath mat. Wall sconces every ~2m cast strong amber light pools (OmniLights with warm colour, about 2x energy plus shadows) on walls and floor. Fix: scale furniture up ~1.3x, add 8-12 props per room along the walls (shelves, frames, plants, lamps), add lit sconces and lamps with real light falloff, and cut the cutaway walls down to a low wainscot height so they show the interiors instead of blank plaster. Secondary: the background is an unreadable blue blur. It needs visible neighbour houses with lit windows, street lamps, trees and a moon, with less aggressive tilt-shift so the ground floor stays readable.

Critic verdicts (5)
  1. R5RefNo generational arc: there are zero aging, life-stage, birthday, romance-progression, move-in, pregnancy or baby systems (grep for birthday/age_up/life_stage/propose/marry/move_in/pregnan/try-for-baby across scripts/ finds nothing). The household is a fixed set of 4 (dad, 2 kids, dog) frozen forever, so the Sims 3 long-term loop (flirt to romance to go steady to propose to move in to try for baby, kids growing to teens and adults, elders dying) is absent. The per-action animation and prop layer from round 4 is now real (shower inside the stall with water fx, eat with fork and plate and a pulled chair, chop then stir, bath, hug and joke pairs; 30/30 playtest steps checked PASS), but in the eat shot the pulled-out chair floats beside the sim. Build it as follows. (1) In scripts/core/game.gd, add per-member age_days and a life_stage (baby, toddler, child, teen, young adult, adult, elder) with a days-per-stage table, a Have Birthday cake action that ages a sim up with a celebration moodlet, auto age-up at the stage limit, and elder old-age death with a grave and a mourning moodlet, all with save/load. (2) In scripts/sim/sim_actions.gd, add romance social tiers gated by relationship plus a romance meter: Flirt, Kiss, Go Steady, Propose, Try for Baby. Track partner state in game.gd. (3) Let a townie (sim_world.gd townie_of) move in via Ask to Move In on the phone or computer, joining the household with a new portrait in hud.gd. (4) Add pregnancy over 3 days with a hospital or home birth that creates a baby member with crib actions in catalog.gd. (5) In scripts/world/actors/sim_rig_builder.gd, give each stage its own scale and proportions. Cover it with playtest steps for age_up, romance_to_propose, move_in and baby_born.
  2. R4RefActions are performed with generic, reused poses, not bespoke Sims 3 animations. The core loop is now real and the playtest passes 79/79: careers with carpool, rabbit hole, performance and promotion, bills, moodlets, autonomy across floors, relationships, wishes, build/buy and travel. But the 'perform' beat that sells every interaction is fake. Only ~18 poses exist (sim_actor.gd), and the only hand props are book, brush/spatula, palette, toothbrush, block and robot. As a result: Take Shower is pose 'idle' with use 'front', so the sim stands OUTSIDE the shower stall. Prepare Snack reuses 'stand_type', the typing pose. Eat and Toilet are a plain 'sit' with no plate, fork or food. Bath is 'lie' with no water. Cook is the 'grill' pose with no pan, food or steam. Chat and Deep Conversation are the same 'talk' loop. To fix, build a per-action animation and prop layer. In scripts/world/actors/sim_actor.gd, add distinct keyframed poses for eat (fork to mouth on a loop), drink, cook_stove (stir a pan), chop, shower (inside the stall, scrubbing, with a water-particle emitter), bath_soak, toilet, wash_hands, plus per-social gestures (laugh, joke, hug, argue, kiss). Give each pose its own hand prop (plate+fork, mug, pan, sponge, phone). In scripts/sim/catalog.gd and scripts/locations/home.gd, fix each action's 'pose' and 'use' (shower/bath 'inside', snack 'counter_chop'). In scripts/sim/sim_agent.gd, add short enter and exit transitions (pull out the chair, step into the shower) and an end-of-action reaction, and cover it with playtest steps that assert pose plus prop. Secondary gaps: no aging, life stages or birthdays, and no romance-to-move-in-to-baby progression, so there is no generational arc. Also, the Tasks panel renders as a tall empty white slab that clips world bubbles (shots/playtest_04, playtest_29).
  3. R3RefNo Sims 3 career loop: money comes from an on-demand 'Work' button on the home Computer (scripts/locations/home.gd: a 120-min type action paying a flat $180, repeatable any hour, any day), and 'Pay Bills' is an optional $120 computer action that never arrives or piles up. So there is no job, no schedule, no carpool, no performance and no promotion, and the money pressure that drives the Sims 3 day does not exist. To build it: (1) add a careers table in a new scripts/sim/careers.gd (e.g. Business, Music, Culinary; levels 1-10 with title, hourly wage, work days and hours, and skill/mood requirements for promotion), and store career/level/performance per member in scripts/core/game.gd, including save/load; (2) let the player join via 'Find a Job' on the Computer/newspaper; (3) in sim_agent.gd, at shift start, force a 'Go to Work' order: the sim walks to the front door, a carpool picks them up, and they disappear for the shift as a rabbit hole while the clock runs. Performance rises with mood and the relevant skill, and the sim comes back with a daily paycheck notification, moodlets and a promotion or demotion with a raise; (4) add a work-tendency choice (Work Hard / Normal / Take It Easy) and a Career tab in sim_overlay.gd with a performance bar; (5) make bills arrive in the mailbox every few days, scaled to household value, with late penalties. Secondary gaps: no traits, so every sim's autonomy is identical; no aging or life stages; and the build is wall pieces from a catalog, not drag-to-build rooms. Also, playtest.sh exits 2 with 12x SCRIPT ERROR because sim_world.gd townie_of(it: Node) is passed a freed node (from wishes.gd:106) before its is_instance_valid guard can run; make the parameter untyped or check validity at the call site.
  4. R2RefAutonomy breaks across floors. The playtest step autonomy_arrives FAILS: a starving Maya (hunger 0.05) autonomously picks Cook on the Fridge, then is still in phase=walk 50s later at 3x speed. She ends at y 3.00 -> 0.00 and never reaches the fridge or starts acting. That is exactly the Sims 3 moment of a hungry sim going downstairs to eat, and here it silently fails. Fix it in scripts/sim/sim_agent.gd (walk/stair-following and arrival logic) together with scripts/sim/nav_grid.gd (inter-level stair links and the final approach cell in front of interactables): add stuck detection with a repath, then a fallback to the next-best target, and make arrival tolerant so a multi-level autonomous path reliably ends in phase=act. Next biggest gap: social is just one-shot Chat/Hug actions. There are no relationship meters, no friend/romance progression, no social menu tiers and no non-household townies to meet, so the Sims 3 relationship loop is missing. Build a per-pair relationship value in scripts/core/game.gd, shown in a Relationships tab of the HUD panel (scripts/ui/hud.gd), with socials in scripts/sim/sim_actions.gd that unlock by relationship level. Catalogue depth (~15 items, no walls or floors in Build) is also far from Sims 3.
  5. R1RefNo mood layer and no consequences: needs just decay as bars (game.gd NEED_DECAY) and nothing reads them except autonomy scoring, so there are no moodlets, no overall mood, and no failure (no passing out at 0 energy, no bladder accident, no hunger warning, no refusing actions). Skills also jump in big chunks (Music 0->0.75 in one short session) with no skill panel, and the queued orders (sim_agent.gd MAX_QUEUE=3) have no visible queue strip to tap and cancel. Build it as follows. Add a mood/moodlet system in scripts/core/game.gd: per member, a moodlets list of {id, icon, label, delta, expires}, an overall mood computed from needs plus moodlets, and a mood_changed signal. In sim_agent.gd, low needs push negative moodlets (Hungry, Tired, Bored, Smelly, Lonely), and completing actions, skill level-ups and tasks push positive ones (Well Rested, Had Fun, Learned Something). Mood scales skill gain and work pay, and need=0 forces an action (pass out / accident) that adds a strong negative moodlet. In scripts/ui/, add a mood plumbob colour (green/yellow/red) on plumbob.gd and portrait.gd, a moodlet row in need_panel.gd, a Sims-3-style action-queue strip of icons next to the selected portrait (tap to cancel), and a skills tab showing level 1-10 bars.
